say: Did you know India has thousands of government schemes, and most people never hear about the ones meant for them?
Meet Yojana+Sahay. A free, independent app that finds the schemes you can actually get.
It opens with live numbers. Over twelve hundred schemes, across thirty four states and union territories, with official links checked, and the last verified time shown right there.
What's happening in your life?
Tap a moment, like a new baby, farming, or a parent turning sixty, and see the schemes that help, step by step.
Family Benefits finds schemes for everyone at home, using the details you share just once.
Or browse by category. Farmers, students, women, seniors, health, housing and more, each with its top benefit amount.
Every state has its own full list, along with the central schemes for all of India.
And popular schemes like P M Kisan and Ayushman Bharat are just one tap away.
Looking for something specific?
Search in English or Hindi, and the right scheme shows up instantly.
The Schemes tab filters by category and state. Open any scheme to see the benefits, who can apply, the documents you need, and how to apply.
Which schemes can you get?
Answer a few simple questions about your work, income, state and family. Yojana+Sahay matches the schemes you qualify for, and explains your results.
Still have a question?
Meet AI Help. It already knows your profile, and answers in Hindi, English or Hinglish, by typing or by voice.
Tap the sparkle to see everything it can do. Find schemes, check for family, spot scams, compare schemes, make document checklists, track applications, and get the latest news.
Find schemes for me asks only what it doesn't know yet. Two quick taps, and fifty three schemes are matched, worth about one lakh rupees a year.
Or simply ask, like which schemes can help a small farmer in Assam.

And it's smart. It knows your profile, so every answer is personal. It uses official scheme data, and can read answers aloud. It shows the schemes you qualify for, lists the documents for all of them, and suggests what to ask next.
Check for family. Ask about your mother, and it checks her eligibility right in the chat, asking only what it doesn't know.
Why am I not eligible? It tells you the exact reason, and what you can do about it.
Compare two schemes side by side, to see which one suits you better.
Get one document checklist for many schemes at once.
Tell it you have applied, and it saves the scheme to My Applications, and reminds you to follow up.
For the latest news and deadlines, it searches the web live, just for your profile.
And type the way you talk. Even a question in Hinglish gets a clear answer.
Got a suspicious message about a scheme? Paste it, and AI Help warns you if it looks like a scam.
Your profile keeps your matched schemes, your saved details, alerts and every setting, in one place.
Edit your profile, send a report or a query, find government helplines, or read the FAQ, each just one tap away.
About Yojana+Sahay explains our mission, what's new, and how the assistant keeps your chats private.
Tap the Dev badge to meet the developer behind the app, with a direct link to the portfolio.
And for any problem, our Grievance Officer is listed with a direct email. Every report is acknowledged within twenty four hours.
Switch between Hindi and English anytime, in light or dark mode.
Prefer chatting?
The same eligibility check runs on Telegram. Open Yojana+Sahay bot, tap Start, answer a few quick questions, and get your schemes right in the chat.

Nine quick questions. Who you are, your state, age, income, and a few more. Then your schemes arrive with yearly amounts. Tap a number for details, check again, switch to Hindi, turn on alerts, or share it with your family.
Using a computer?
The Yojana+Sahay website has a page for every scheme, in English and Hindi, easy to find on Google.
There are free QR posters to print for your village, a scheme finder other websites can embed, and our full scheme list, published as open data.
How do we keep it accurate?
Behind the app is our admin dashboard. It tracks the whole platform, while keeping everyone's personal data private.
The Verify tab re-checks the official page of every scheme. Broken links, new amounts and changed deadlines are flagged for review.
So who does all this checking?

Five smart agents, working every day. Scheme Discovery finds schemes that aren't in the app yet. The Background Verifier re-reads official pages for deadlines. U R L Repair fixes broken apply links. News Refresh writes short scheme news in English and Hindi. And Deadline Alerts remind you before a scheme closes.
Every change waits for our admin team. Once approved, it goes live in the app automatically, like these real updates from this week.
Deadline alerts and short scheme news, in English and Hindi, are prepared right here too.
Yojana+Sahay is free and independent. It never asks for money or O T P, and always sends you to the official website to apply.
Yojana+Sahay. Find the schemes you deserve. Visit yojana sahay dot vercel dot app, or search Yojana+Sahay bot on Telegram.
